faq.question: What does Razorpay do?
faq.answer: Razorpay is a complete payment and banking solution for businesses. We help you accept online payments, manage business banking, get instant credit, and handle all financial operations from one platform.

faq.question: Who is Razorpay for?
faq.answer: Razorpay is built for all types of businesses - from freelancers and small businesses to large enterprises and startups. Whether you're an e-commerce store, SaaS company, educational institution, or any business that needs to collect payments, we've got you covered.

faq.question: Do you have a free tier?
faq.answer: We don't have a traditional free tier, but there are zero setup fees and no annual maintenance charges. You only pay per transaction - 2% for domestic payments and 3% for international. This means you only pay when you earn.

faq.question: What payment methods do you support?
faq.answer: We support 100+ payment methods including UPI (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm), all major credit and debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, Amex, RuPay), net banking from 50+ banks, popular wallets like Paytm, Mobikwik, and international payment methods.

faq.question: How quickly do I get my money?
faq.answer: We offer instant settlements for eligible merchants. You can get your money in minutes. For standard merchants, settlements happen within T+2 to T+7 days depending on your business category and settlement cycle.

faq.question: Is it difficult to integrate?
faq.answer: Not at all! We have easy integration options for everyone. If you have a website, our APIs can be integrated in 15 minutes. If you don't have a website, use Payment Links or Payment Pages - no coding required. We also have plugins for Shopify, WooCommerce, Magento, and other platforms.

faq.question: What is RazorpayX?
faq.answer: RazorpayX is our business banking platform. It gives you a current account, automated payroll, vendor payments, corporate cards, and complete expense management - all integrated with your payment gateway. Think of it as your complete financial operations platform.

faq.question: Can I get business loans?
faq.answer: Yes! Through Razorpay Capital, you can get instant business loans up to ₹1 crore based on your transaction history. It's collateral-free with minimal documentation and quick disbursement.

faq.question: Do you support international payments?
faq.answer: Absolutely! We support international card payments and popular international payment methods. You can accept payments from customers worldwide at 3% per transaction.

faq.question: What about security and compliance?
faq.answer: We are PCI DSS Level 1 compliant, which is the highest security standard in the payments industry. We're also certified by Visa and Mastercard. Your customer data is encrypted and we follow RBI guidelines strictly.

faq.question: How is your customer support?
faq.answer: We provide 24/7 customer support via email, phone, and chat. Our average response time is under 1 hour, and we have dedicated account managers for enterprise clients.

faq.question: What's your pricing for high-volume businesses?
faq.answer: We offer custom pricing for businesses with high transaction volumes. Our enterprise plans include volume discounts, dedicated support, custom integrations, and priority settlements. Contact our sales team for a personalized quote.
